# hetznerrobot_server_products (Data Source)

Lists the server products of the standard range Robot currently offers, optionally filtered by price and location.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_server_products" "affordable" {
  location  = "FSN1"
  max_price = 60
}

output "affordable_products" {
  value = data.hetznerrobot_server_products.affordable.products[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `location` (String) Only products offered in this location, e.g. `FSN1`.
- `max_price` (Number) Maximum monthly price.
- `max_price_setup` (Number) Maximum one-time setup fee.
- `min_price` (Number) Minimum monthly price.
- `min_price_setup` (Number) Minimum one-time setup fee.

### Read-Only

- `products` (Attributes List) The products. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--products))

<a id="nestedatt--products"></a>
### Nested Schema for `products`

Read-Only:

- `description` (List of String) Textual description, one line per component.
- `dists` (List of String) Distributions that can be preinstalled.
- `id` (String) Product id, e.g. `EX44` — the `product_id` of `hetznerrobot_server_order`.
- `langs` (List of String) Languages of the distributions.
- `locations` (List of String) Locations the product is offered in.
- `name` (String) Product name.
- `orderable_addons` (Attributes List) Addons that can be ordered with the server, e.g. `primary_ipv4`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--products--orderable_addons))
- `prices` (Attributes List) Prices per location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--products--prices))
- `traffic` (String) Included traffic.

<a id="nestedatt--products--orderable_addons"></a>
### Nested Schema for `products.orderable_addons`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Addon id, as `addons` of the order takes it.
- `max` (Number) Maximum orderable amount.
- `min` (Number) Minimum orderable amount.
- `name` (String) Addon name.
- `prices` (Attributes List) Prices per location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--products--orderable_addons--prices))

<a id="nestedatt--products--orderable_addons--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `products.orderable_addons.prices`

Read-Only:

- `hourly_gross` (String) Hourly price with VAT; null when the product is not billed hourly.
- `hourly_net` (String) Hourly price without VAT; null when the product is not billed hourly.
- `location` (String) Location the price applies to.
- `monthly_gross` (String) Monthly price with VAT.
- `monthly_net` (String) Monthly price without VAT.
- `setup_gross` (String) One-time setup fee with VAT.
- `setup_net` (String) One-time setup fee without VAT.



<a id="nestedatt--products--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `products.prices`

Read-Only:

- `hourly_gross` (String) Hourly price with VAT; null when the product is not billed hourly.
- `hourly_net` (String) Hourly price without VAT; null when the product is not billed hourly.
- `location` (String) Location the price applies to.
- `monthly_gross` (String) Monthly price with VAT.
- `monthly_net` (String) Monthly price without VAT.
- `setup_gross` (String) One-time setup fee with VAT.
- `setup_net` (String) One-time setup fee without VAT.
